title: HouseVis: devices
description: The devices that show the house. Each device has, per orientation, a sequence of pages; a page shows views from the views/ folder placed on it, or the Loxone web interface alone. Which device the Windows app shows is chosen in its menu and stored; without a choice, "default" applies. See docs/devices.md.

^(\\$schema|_.*)$.description: Reference to the schema or a comment; ignored.

default.description: Id of the device the Windows app shows without a choice of its own.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 40 characters (also UUIDs).

platform.description: desktop: Windows, macOS and Linux (they behave the same); android; ios.

aspect.description: Screen shape in landscape as a ratio, e.g. 16:10; portrait swaps it. Only for the editor's preview.

keepAwake.description: While the app is on screen, the display neither dims nor sleeps (e.g. a wall tablet). Default false.

presenceRoom.description: A room of house.json with a presence datapoint: while it reports nobody there, the screen turns black (Android: lowest backlight) and the app keeps running; presence brings it back at once, and a tap wakes it for a minute. The screen then never sleeps, as with keepAwake.

lightMode.description: How light sources are drawn on this device: real with three.js lights, simple with glowing bodies and painted pools of light, for weaker devices (docs/lights.md). Default: simple on android, real otherwise.

reducedFrameRate.description: Every animation (presence glow, anemometer, moving windows, clouds, rain, snow) steps 10 times a second instead of 30, for weak devices. Default false.

portrait.description: If missing, the landscape pages apply (and vice versa).

title.description: Short text in the navigation bar.

icon.description: Name of a Lucide icon from the app's list (src/model/pageIcons.ts).

components.description: What the page shows, each placed in percent of the page.

weather.description: Only with components: the current weather as the page's sky behind all its views, rain or snow lightly over them (docs/weather.md). Needs the weather roles in house.json ("data"); drawn once however many views the page holds.

loxone.description: The Loxone web interface, alone and filling the page, wherever the user left it (it cannot be steered from outside). No settings yet.

view.description: Id of a view in views/.

frame.description: Drawn with a frame and its title.
